summary.en: Sonoko sleeps inside Michiwaki's Station Wagon, while Conan, Ran and Michiwaki are eating in the restaurant. Just then, Conan realizes that the car is moving and Sonoko is still in the car. Conan and Ran run to stop the car, and just when the car is about to fall into the cliff, Ran broke the window and saved Sonoko in time, and the car fell into the cliff. Conan believes the culprit was the serial killer who attacked Sonoko last night. While they walk to the police station, Sonoko says that she does have one picture left, which is the one she wants to show Shinichi. Conan realizes that culprit still thinks that Sonoko has an incriminating picture and has sent the car over the cliff to destroy it along with the luggage. But he's still confused as to why the culprit thinks such a picture exist.
